instruction: Make picture1.jpg read-only by removing write permissions from the file in the Pictures directory.

metadata.explanation: Task requires making picture1.jpg read-only by removing write permissions (e.g., using chmod 444 or similar). Custom getter retrieves file permissions for picture1.jpg using Python stat module. Custom metric verifies file is readable but not writable (read-only status).
metadata.verification: Verified read-only logic: file must have read permission but not write permission. Uses Python stat module to check st_mode flags.
